capability_gaps: Existing k3s/PV/MCP service data must be inventoried and migrated to separate service storage before concurrent guest writes
Guest EFI Boot Bridge and kernel/initramfs update tracking are not implemented; an ext4 partition alone is not a bootable disk
P0/P1 produces plans only; physical-device apply and real libvirt execution are unavailable

operations.description: Hash documented GPT/ESP/boot-critical regions and record a trusted content generation before access; a topology digest is insufficient
Prepare independent qcow2 overlay "trial-675fbad72d826441" with explicit raw read-only physical backing; validate raw block behavior on owned file/loop fixtures first
Guest writes go only to the overlay; open base read-only and verify critical-region hashes after guest shutdown
Plan independent persistent OVMF variable storage; never map Host NVRAM into a guest
Plan a separate guest EFI/boot disk, update-aware kernel/initramfs bridge, private swap and reversible guest fstab/resume handling

preconditions.detail: Immediately before access, rediscover stable identity, capacity, GPT GUID and PARTUUIDs; never reuse kernel device paths
PARTUUID 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111 or its parent disk is mounted or active swap; native and managed access must be exclusive
Mount, swap, kernel-holder, other namespace and hypervisor ownership must be known; missing observations deny writable guest access
Reconcile actual Host/VM/process/kernel ownership and acquire hierarchy-aware exclusive leases before attaching a base or overlay
Insufficient base fingerprint: require size, GPT GUID, PARTUUIDs, critical-region SHA-256 and trusted content generation
Validate explicit backing formats, read-only backing enforcement, base immutability and shutdown on owned files before real devices

rollback: Stop the trial domain and verify all I/O has ceased before releasing leases
Preserve diagnostic overlay separately or discard it; never commit/rebase its writes into the physical base automatically
Reject an old overlay and any saved memory if the base fingerprint/generation changed in Native mode
